title: working 3
content:
Goal: collect Windows reference behaviour for OpenMaui (the Linux MAUI backend) to check against. Do NOT
  edit maui-linux source; produce data and a report. Put everything in a folder windows-reference/ on a branch
  named windows-reference and push it to Gitea (origin).

  1. Fact-check these "as on Windows" claims with a small net10.0-windows MAUI test app (one page per item,
  screenshot + the measured numbers):
     - Button LineBreakMode WordWrap / CharacterWrap: does a long text wrap onto lines and does the button
  grow? TailTruncation / HeadTruncation / MiddleTruncation with and without an icon (ImageSource).
     - Syncfusion SfComboBox (34.2.9), single selection, no WidthRequest: its size in a VerticalStackLayout, a
  HorizontalStackLayout, a Grid Auto column and a FlexLayout, in a 600-wide window.
     - CollectionView with ItemsUpdatingScrollMode.KeepItemsInView: scroll down, add an item at index 0: does
  the list jump to the top?
     - NavigationPage with no BarBackground: what colour is the bar (the page background, or a system colour)?
     - Wrapped Label (WordWrap) with HorizontalOptions=Start: is its width the widest line or the full width 
  offered?
     - Accelerometer.Start() and Stop() on a machine without the sensor: exception type.
     - Window.DisplayDensity value; Window.Width/Height after the window opens.
     - RotationY = 180 on a Label: mirrored flat, or drawn with perspective?
     Record exact sizes (VisualElement.Width/Height/Frame) and a screenshot per case, in 
  windows-reference/facts.md.

  2. Event sequences: for each interaction below, log every event raised (name, sender AutomationId, 
  timestamp, order) to JSON:
     - Tab through 3 Entries and a Button; type "abc" in one; click the Button.
     - Press, drag off and release a Button; press and release it.
     - Scroll a CollectionView of 100 items to the bottom; tap an item; SelectionChanged.
     - NavigationPage push and pop; Shell route change; modal push and pop.
     - Resize the window from 800x600 to 600x400 (SizeChanged on page and a child).
     Write windows-reference/events/<scenario>.json.

  3. Screenshots of the CiteLynq app on Windows, window size 1400x1050, for these routes: //home //library 
  //notifications //questions //notes //chats //economy //search. Save as 
  windows-reference/citelynq/<route>.png.

  Report: windows-reference/README.md listing every item, what was measured and anything surprising.
